quotes.en: So, Alexandrova gets the first break of the opening set.
quotes.zh: 阿历克山德洛娃完成首盘第一次破发。

quotes.en: Good return again from Alexandrova. And she has a double break lead. Bit of a surprise.
quotes.zh: 阿历克山德洛娃再次打出漂亮接发。她已经领先两个破发，确实有些出人意料。

quotes.en: Oh, what a backhand for Alexandrova to close out the opening set. So, two breaks of serve and she hands Linda Noskova her first set loss in her last six matches. An upset brewing perhaps in round four.
quotes.zh: 阿历克山德洛娃用一记精彩反拍收下首盘。两次破发，让诺斯科娃在最近六场比赛中首次丢盘。第四轮，冷门正在酝酿。

quotes.en: So now three match points for Ekaterina Alexandrova.
quotes.zh: 现在，阿历克山德洛娃拿到三个赛点。

quotes.en: And what a way to finish for Ekaterina Alexandrova.
quotes.zh: 阿历克山德洛娃用这样的方式结束比赛！

quotes.en: A dominant effort against the Wimbledon champion who hasn't lost since the US Open.
quotes.zh: 面对美网后未尝败绩的温网冠军，她打出了压倒性的表现。

quotes.en: Had a five match win streak going that is now gone.
quotes.zh: 诺斯科娃的五连胜，就此终结。
